findings.explanation: data/splunkbase-catalog.json lists Splunkbase 1747 as 'Splunk Add-on for Cisco WSA' (Splunk_TA_cisco-wsa), not the REST API Modular Input. The same id is repeated in implementation, detailedImplementation and references.
findings.quote: Use the REST API Modular Input (Splunkbase app ID 1747)
findings.suggested_fix: Look up the correct Splunkbase id for REST API Modular Input (commonly 1546; verify on Splunkbase) and fix all four fields.

findings.explanation: The SPL alerts on connection_status != online, recording_status != recording or storage_util_pct > 90, and does not aggregate a count; the description names only the storage condition.
findings.quote: Outputs `count` each `the scheduled window`; alert when `storage_util_pct` > 90.
findings.suggested_fix: List all three conditions and drop the count wording.

findings.explanation: Sibling UC-15.3.4 monitors the same camera health signal with sourcetype vms:camera_status and the literal 'connected' where this UC uses 'online'; the guide lists vendor sourcetypes (axis:camera, genetec:event, milestone:event).
findings.suggested_fix: Harmonise sourcetypes and status literals or document the vendor mapping.

findings.explanation: The URL (Data/MonitorRESTfulAPIs) is presented as core Splunk documentation for the REST modular input; confirm the page exists and covers the add-on.
findings.quote: Splunk Documentation — Monitor data from REST APIs
findings.suggested_fix: Link to the REST API Modular Input's own documentation on Splunkbase.

findings.explanation: No real camera cause (scheduled recording mode, NVR firmware restarts, disks in RAID rebuild) is named and the fields are not in the SPL.

summary: Good vendor-specific implementation text, but it names Splunkbase app 1747 as the REST API Modular Input, which the repository catalog lists as a different add-on, and the description reports only one of three alert conditions.
